summary.text: Blake Stevens is the Democratic candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was also a Democratic candidate for the District 7 seats in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Stevens was born in Springfield, Minnesota, and graduated from Red Rock Central Senior High School; Ballotpedia lists his profession as student.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in a small Midwest town, worked blue-collar jobs, returned to college in 2022 to study political science, and plans to attend law school.
He finished fourth in the November 5, 2024 general election for the two District 7 seats, with 17.3 percent of the vote.

In that survey, Stevens said his priorities included workers' rights and higher wages, lower living costs through investment in public infrastructure, housing and transit, universal pre-kindergarten, and expanded access to Medicare and lower drug costs.
